name: Weekly Earnings Screener
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 23 * * 0'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  run:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - name: Run screener
        run: |
          mkdir -p reports
          python weekly_screener.py > reports/weekly_$(date +%Y-%m-%d).txt 2>&1
      - name: Save report
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions"
          git config user.email "actions@github.com"
          git add reports/
          git commit -m "Weekly $(date +%Y-%m-%d)" || echo "nothing to commit"
          git push
